listitem.para: class PlayerStatsDisplay
Displays the player stats in the shop.
class ShopBaseTab
Base class for all shop tabs. Contains methods to get price tags and parse prices from them.
class ShopButtons
Custom button class for the shop buttons, which sets the text of the button based on the buy status of the weapon/item.
class ShopMenu
Custom control class for the shop menu, which handles opening and closing the shop menu.
class ShopPrices
Manages the text of the price tags in the shop and calculates the price of the items.
class ShopStatsTab
Manages the stats tab of thje shop. Buys stats and increases the player stats based on the bought stats.
class ShopWeaponsTab
Manages the weapons tab of the shop. Buys weapons and equips them based on the bought weapons.
class ShopWeaponStatsDisplay
Displays the weapon stats in the shop.
struct Stat
Data struct which holds the name, list index, price, price tag, and quantity of a stat.
struct Weapon
Data class which holds the weapon stats.
